newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, France agree to normalise air traffic.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, France agree to normalise air traffic.

text.p: Croatia and France signed an agreement on Monday to normalise air traffic, state radio reported.
The accord was signed by Transport Minister Zeljko Luzavec and his French counterpart Bernard Pons on a visit to Croatia.
Croatia, formerly part of communist Yugoslavia, has to formally re-establish links with foreign countries after five years of war that followed its declaration of independence in 1991.
Both ministers said cooperation between the two countries in other fields of transport and telecommunications also showed steady progress.
Pons is scheduled to meet Croatian President Franjo Tudjman and Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa later in the day. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
